_comment: Tamreen behaviour knobs, same pattern as quiz.json.
_comment-auto: How long an answer stays on screen before the next question, in milliseconds. The Quiz's own waits, repeated here so Tamreen can be retuned on its own: a right answer needs only a glance, a wrong one has to be read.
_comment-typo: Search tolerance: exact/substring tried first; a typed word within this many edits of a candidate word still matches. The looser distance only kicks in for longer words, where one stray edit is still clearly the same word.
